data.assumption: I interpreted “last week” as the previous Monday-through-Sunday business-date week, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-06, and “card attempts failed in the UK” as non-test payment attempts with method = 'card' and status = 'failed' at UK showrooms.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_card_attempts
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-07'
  AND c.name = 'United Kingdom'
  AND pa.method = 'card'
  AND pa.status = 'failed'
